notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
description:
Cast Furnace Hellkite by paying {R}{R}.
When Furnace Hellkite enters the battlefield, Ganax and Lathliss trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Ganax trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Furnace Hellkite from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
